messages.바티: 오늘은 성장 확인이 우선입니다. 후반 도둑 하나만 놓치지 않으면: Bati: Today, checking growth comes first. Just don't let that one late thief slip away.
messages.성장 예고: 푸딩, 고브, 핀의 다음 역할을 확인했다. (growth_p: Growth preview: Reviewed the next roles for Pudding, Gob, and Pynn. (growth_preview)
Monster roles: Rolo remains on expedition/scouting support until ready for defense placement.
messages.왕국이 단순 탐험가 대신 조사관 아이리스를 보낸다. 적은 길과 방 배치를: The kingdom sends Investigator Iris instead of ordinary explorers. Enemies begin reading the paths and room layout.
messages.신규 적 클래스 왕국 조사관이 등장합니다. 탐험가보다 단단하고 목표는 왕: A new enemy class appears: Kingdom Investigator. Tougher than explorers, they target the Throne. Check your Barracks and Watch Post placements along the main route.
messages.신규 적을 가르치는 날이다. 조사관은 1명만 등장시키고 탐험가/도둑으로: A day for teaching the new enemy type. Introduce only 1 investigator and mix in explorers/thieves for varied pressure.
messages.조사관을 주 경로에서 붙잡기: Hold the investigator on the main route
messages.도둑 추격과 조사관 마무리: Chase thieves and finish off the investigator
messages.탐험가 무리 화력 처리: Use firepower to clear explorer groups
messages.아이리스: 이 성의 방 배치는 우연이 아니군요. 전열과 보물 방 사이의: Iris: This castle's room layout is no accident. I'll document the flow between the front line and the Treasury.
messages.바티: 조사관은 탐험가보다 오래 버팁니다. 주 경로에서 붙잡고 후방 도둑: Bati: Investigators last longer than explorers. Hold them on the main route and deal with thieves in the rear separately.
Iris: Entrance, Barracks, Throne. I see the intent behind this defense line.
messages.바티: 조사관 1명, 도둑 2명입니다. 오늘은 배치가 흐트러지면 바로 티: Bati: 1 investigator and 2 thieves. Any gaps in our placements will show immediately today.
messages.신규 적 확인: 왕국 조사관은 왕좌를 목표로 움직이며 탐험가보다 오래 버: New enemy identified: Kingdom Investigators move toward the Throne and last longer than explorers. (investigator_class)
messages.DAY 10 길드 게시판의 이름: DAY 10 A Name on the Guild Board
messages.마왕성의 이름이 길드 게시판에 오른다. 조사관의 보고 뒤 수련생 용사가: The Demon Castle's name appears on the guild board. Following the investigator's report, a trainee hero returns with heavier pressure.
messages.1장 마감 전투입니다. 조사관과 도둑, 수련생 용사가 섞여 나오지만 게임: The closing battle of Chapter 1. Investigators, thieves, and a trainee hero arrive together, but the game proceeds to next-chapter preparation instead of ending in overall victory.
messages.DAY 08~09에서 배운 성장/배치/혼합 압박을 한 번에 확인한다. 총: Checks growth, placement, and mixed pressure learned in DAY 08–09 together. 6 enemies total, with the final trainee hero as the climax.
messages.탐험가 전열 유지: Hold the front line against explorers
messages.길드 게시판 정보 수집: Gathering Information from the Guild Board
messages.조사 보고 후속 압박: Follow-Up Pressure from the Investigation Report
messages.조사 보고 후속 확인: Follow-Up Check on the Investigation Report
messages.바티: 길드 게시판에 우리 성 이름이 올라갔습니다. 이제 우연히 찾아오는: Bati: Our castle's name is on the guild board. Our visitors are no longer stumbling in by chance.
Iris: My investigation report is submitted. Official subjugation procedures come next, I suppose.
Leon: This time, I'll check the route before entering. I won't get lost like last time.
messages.바티: 오늘을 넘기면 1장은 정리됩니다. 단, 전쟁은 이제 막 알려졌을: Bati: Get through today, and Chapter 1 is settled. But word of this war has only just begun to spread.
messages.1장 클리어: 마왕성의 이름이 길드 게시판에 올랐다. (chapter_o: Chapter 1 cleared: The Demon Castle's name appeared on the guild board. (chapter_one_clear)
Next chapter preparation: The kingdom has begun taking notice of the castle's layout and monster growth.
messages.길드 게시판 사건 뒤 왕국이 공식 경고문을 붙인다. 침입자는 더 체계적으: After the guild board incident, the kingdom posts an official warning. Intruders begin checking routes and the Treasury more systematically.
messages.2장 시작 전투입니다. 새 비주얼 스테이지로 전환하지 않고, 기존 성에서: The opening battle of Chapter 2. Show the kingdom's official response in the existing castle first, without switching to a new visual stage.
messages.DAY 10보다 약간 짧게 재정렬한다. 총 7명, 조사관 1명과 도둑 2: Regroup with a slightly shorter battle than DAY 10. 7 enemies total, including 1 investigator and 2 thieves, retest placement and Treasury defense.
messages.탐험가 전열 지연: Delay explorers at the front line
messages.조사관과 후속 전열 정리: Clear the investigator and following frontline enemies
messages.왕국 경고문 정찰 보고. 방어 배치는 계속 보류: Scouting report on the royal warning. Defense placement remains deferred
messages.공식 토벌 전 사전 확인대: Advance Survey Team Before Official Subjugation
messages.경고문 이후 구조 재확인: Rechecking the Layout After the Warning
messages.바티: 왕국 경고문입니다. 표현은 점잖지만, 내용은 토벌 준비가 시작됐다: Bati: A royal warning. Politely worded, but it means preparations to subjugate us have begun.
messages.로로: 게시판 뒤쪽에 경고문 사본이 붙었어. 정찰은 내가 계속 돌게. 방: Rolo: A copy of the warning is posted behind the board. I'll keep scouting. Defense battles are still beyond me.
messages.바티: 성의 모양을 바꾸는 건 아직 이릅니다. 오늘은 기존 구조로 공식: Bati: It's too early to change the castle's appearance. Today, we face their official response with our current layout.
messages.아이리스: 경고문 이후 첫 확인입니다. 입구, 병영, 보물 방 순서로 기: Iris: First inspection after the warning. I'll document the entrance, Barracks, and Treasury, in that order.
messages.2장 시작: 왕국은 마왕성을 공식 위협 후보로 기록했다. (chapter: Chapter 2 begins: The kingdom has listed the Demon Castle as a potential official threat. (chapter_two_started)
messages.자산 결정: DAY 11은 기존 성/적/초상 자산을 재사용하고 Stage: Asset decision: DAY 11 reuses existing castle/enemy/portrait assets; the Stage 02 visual transition is deferred.
messages.푸딩, 고브, 핀 중 한 명이 2장 첫 승급 후보가 된다. 승급은 아직: One of Pudding, Gob, or Pynn becomes Chapter 2's first promotion candidate. Promotion improves roles and stats without changing appearance yet.
messages.몬스터 관리에서 Lv.3 이상 몬스터를 골라 첫 승급을 실행하세요. DA: Choose a monster at Lv.3 or higher in Monster Management for its first promotion. Immediately after DAY 11, 1 training session can bring it to Lv.3.
messages.진화 계획표의 첫 플레이어블 범위다. 2장에서는 승급 1명을 기대하고,: The first playable portion of the evolution roadmap. Chapter 2 expects 1 promoted monster; rather than simply raising enemy HP, mix investigators/thieves/trainee heroes to test role responses.
messages.성문 방벽 푸딩은 DAY12 기준선 승급. 전열 안정화와 입구 지연 담당: Gate Bulwark Pudding is the baseline DAY12 promotion, stabilizing the front line and delaying enemies at the entrance
messages.매복대장 고브는 도둑 대응 승급. 보물 방 압박을 줄이는 선택지: Ambush Captain Gob is the anti-thief promotion, offering a way to ease Treasury pressure
messages.화염 숙련자 핀은 조사관/탐험가 정리 승급. 전열 대체가 아닌 화력 보조: Flame Adept Pynn is the promotion for clearing investigators/explorers: fire support, not a frontline replacement
messages.로로는 승급 재료 단서만 제공하고 방어 배치는 계속 보류: Rolo only provides clues to promotion materials; defense placement remains deferred
messages.승급 전열 체감용 기본 압박: Basic Pressure to Demonstrate the Promoted Front Line
messages.방 배치 분석 압박 유지: Maintain pressure from room layout analysis
messages.고브 승급 선택지도 의미 있게 만드는 보물 방 압박: Treasury pressure that also makes Gob's promotion a meaningful choice
messages.승급 1명 체감 검증용 약한 후반 압박: Light late pressure to assess the impact of 1 promoted monster
messages.바티: 2장부터는 몬스터 하나를 먼저 승급시킬 수 있습니다. 아직 형태: Bati: From Chapter 2, you can promote one monster first. Appearance changes remain on hold; only roles and stats improve.
Pudding: If I can block the entrance longer, I'll take the front.
Gob: Catching thieves? You can't leave me out of that.
Pynn: If that investigator comes back, I'll burn those notes this time.
messages.바티: 오늘은 승급 1명을 기준으로 압박이 들어옵니다. 전열, 추격, 화: Bati: Today's pressure assumes 1 promoted monster. Your choice of front line, pursuit, or firepower will shape the result.
messages.첫 승급 해금: 몬스터 승급은 1단계 역할 강화로 시작한다. (first: First promotion unlocked: Monster promotion begins with a stage 1 role upgrade. (first_promotion)
messages.밸런스 기준: 2장 초반은 승급 1명, 3장은 승급 2~3명을 기대하도록: Balance baseline: Early Chapter 2 is tuned for 1 promoted monster, and Chapter 3 for 2–3.
messages.왕국이 첫 승급 기록을 보고 느리고 단단한 방패병을 섞어 보낸다. 두 번: After reviewing the first promotion records, the kingdom adds slow, sturdy shieldbearers to its forces. The second promotion remains deferred for lack of data.
messages.방패병은 느리지만 전열을 오래 붙잡는 역할 카운터입니다. 승급 1명과 감: Shieldbearers are slow role counters that tie up the front line. Buy time by combining 1 promoted monster with Watch Posts/Spike Corridors.
messages.진화 계획표상 2장 초반은 승급 1명 유지다. DAY13은 두 번째 승급: The evolution roadmap keeps early Chapter 2 at 1 promoted monster. DAY13 does not unlock a second promotion. New shieldbearers challenge pure frontline reliance, but all three promotion choices must remain viable.
messages.두 번째 승급은 DAY23 계획표까지 보류한다. DAY13~15는 첫 승: The second promotion is deferred until DAY23 on the roadmap. DAY13–15 test enemy role counters and facility decisions with only 1 initial promotion.
messages.방패병을 막아 세우되 단독 장기전 의존은 위험하다는 기준선: Baseline: hold shieldbearers, but relying on a prolonged solo fight is risky
messages.느린 방패병 사이로 도둑을 끊는 추격 선택지: Pursuit option: intercept thieves among the slow shieldbearers
messages.방패병 뒤 기본 적을 빠르게 정리하는 화력 선택지: Firepower option: quickly clear basic enemies behind shieldbearers
messages.방패병 대응과 승급 제한 안내: Guide to Shieldbearer Counters and Promotion Limits
messages.왕국이 첫 승급을 분석했다는 절차형 압박: Procedural pressure showing that the kingdom analyzed the first promotion
messages.방패병 전 기본 전열 확인: Basic Frontline Check Before the Shieldbearer
messages.느리고 단단한 역할 카운터 신규 적: New Enemy: A Slow, Sturdy Role Counter
messages.방패병에 시선이 묶인 상태에서 보물 압박: Treasure pressure while attention is tied up by the shieldbearer
messages.바티: 왕국이 어제 승급 기록을 봤습니다. 오늘은 느리고 단단한 방패병을: Bati: The kingdom reviewed yesterday's promotion records. Today, slow, sturdy shieldbearers will keep our front line occupied.
messages.바티: 두 번째 승급은 아직 보류합니다. 자료가 부족한 상태에서 문어발: Bati: The second promotion stays on hold. Spreading promotions too widely without enough data will cloud our frontline decisions.
messages.골딘: 느린 적이라고 방치하면 수리비가 길게 늘어납니다. 감시초소와 가시: Goldin: Ignore a slow enemy, and your repair bill keeps growing. I recommend Watch Posts and Spike Corridors.
messages.아이리스: 신규 대응 병과 투입. 방패병은 진입 속도보다 버티는 시간을: Iris: Deploying a new counter unit. For shieldbearers, I'll prioritize recording endurance over entry speed.
messages.신규 적 확인: 왕국 방패병은 느리고 단단한 전열 카운터다. (shiel: New enemy identified: Kingdom Shieldbearers are slow, sturdy frontline counters. (shieldbearer_class)
messages.승급 기록: 두 번째 승급은 DAY23 계획까지 보류하고, 2장 초반은: Promotion record: The second promotion is deferred until the DAY23 plan; early Chapter 2 is tuned for 1 promoted monster. (second_promotion_deferred)
messages.DAY 13 adds a dedicated 왕국 방패병 combat sp: DAY 13 adds a dedicated Kingdom Shieldbearer combat sprite set: idle, move, attack, skill, down.
messages.골딘과 바티가 Stage 02 성 심사 비용을 계산한다. 오늘 목표는 외: Goldin and Bati calculate the Stage 02 castle inspection fee. Today's goal is funding and security, not a visual transition.
messages.보물 방을 지키며 Stage 02 심사 비용을 확보하세요. 두 번째 승급: Protect the Treasury and secure the Stage 02 inspection fee. The second promotion is still locked, and the actual castle visual transition is deferred until after DAY 15.
messages.DAY14는 새 승급이나 새 적 없이 자원/보안 판단을 확인한다. 첫 승: DAY14 tests resource/security decisions without a new promotion or enemy. Increase thief pressure around 1 promoted monster; victory should secure the Stage 02 inspection fee.
messages.전열이 무너지면 보물 방으로 압박이 새는 기준선: Baseline: a collapsed front line lets pressure spill into the Treasury
messages.도둑 2명 압박에서 보물 손실을 줄이는 추격 선택지: Pursuit option: reduce treasure losses under pressure from 2 thieves
messages.탐험가와 조사관을 빠르게 줄여 도둑 대응 시간을 만드는 화력 선택지: Firepower option: clear explorers and investigators quickly to make time for thieves
messages.DAY 15 승리 뒤 성 외형 전환과 보안 우선순위 안내: Guide to the castle visual transition after DAY 15 victory and security priorities
messages.DAY13 방패병을 1회만 재사용해 전열 시간을 늘림: Reuse the DAY13 shieldbearer only 1 time to prolong the frontline engagement
messages.업그레이드 비용 보유 상태에서 보물 손실 압박: Treasure loss pressure while holding upgrade funds
messages.골딘: Stage 02 성 심사 비용은 금화 720, 악명 720으로 잡: Goldin: The Stage 02 castle inspection fee is set at 720 gold and 720 Infamy. Any treasure loss will put that at risk.
messages.바티: 오늘은 성을 바꾸는 날이 아니라 심사 비용을 맞추는 날입니다. 실: Bati: Today is for meeting the inspection fee, not changing the castle. The actual transition comes right after passing Selen's inspection tomorrow.
messages.골딘: 도둑을 놓치면 회계 장부가 먼저 쓰러집니다. 보물 방 주변 방어를: Goldin: Let a thief slip by, and the ledger will fall first. Check the defenses around the Treasury.
messages.바티: 심사 전날의 침입은 늘 장부를 노립니다. 오늘 목표는 승리와 비용: Bati: Invasions on the eve of inspection always target the ledger. Today, we need victory and our funds intact.
messages.Stage 02 준비: 심사 비용을 지켰다. DAY 15 셀렌 점검을 통: Stage 02 preparation: Protected the inspection funds. Passing Selen's DAY 15 inspection will change the castle's appearance. (stage_two_transition_armed)
messages.운영 기준: DAY14는 두 번째 승급 없이 첫 승급 1명과 시설 배치로: Management baseline: DAY14 is about protecting funds with 1 initial promotion and facility placement, without a second promotion. (stage_two_review_day)
messages.Stage 02 심사 비용을 마련한 뒤, 성기사 견습 셀렌이 점검표를 들: After the Stage 02 inspection fee is secured, apprentice paladin Selen arrives with a checklist for the boss inspection battle.
messages.DAY 14에서 Stage 02 심사 비용을 마련해야 시작할 수 있습니다: On DAY 14, secure the Stage 02 inspection fee before you can begin. The second promotion remains locked; the Selen boss is balanced around 1 initial promotion.
messages.2장 보스전이다. 절차형 보스 셀렌을 새 적 클래스로 등장시키되, 몬스터: Chapter 2's boss battle. Introduce procedural boss Selen as a new enemy class, but follow the monster evolution roadmap and keep the second promotion locked until DAY23.
messages.두 번째 승급은 DAY23 계획표까지 보류한다. DAY15 셀렌 보스도: The second promotion is deferred until DAY23 on the roadmap. Validate the DAY15 Selen boss balance with only 1 initial promotion as well.
messages.성문 방벽 푸딩 선택지는 방패병과 셀렌을 오래 붙잡는 기준선: Gate Bulwark Pudding is the baseline choice for holding the shieldbearer and Selen longer
messages.매복대장 고브 선택지는 중반 도둑 1명을 끊고 셀렌 마무리에 합류: Ambush Captain Gob intercepts 1 mid-battle thief, then joins the final push against Selen
messages.셀렌 보스 후반: Late in the Selen Boss Battle
messages.화염 숙련자 핀 선택지는 탐험가/조사관을 빨리 정리해 보스 교전 시간을: Flame Adept Pynn quickly clears explorers/investigators to make time for the boss engagement
messages.심사 게이트와 승급 제한 안내: Guide to Inspection Requirements and Promotion Limits
messages.레온이 보고서를 읽고 있다는 장기 라이벌 암시: Hint at a long-term rivalry: Leon is reading the reports
messages.보스 전 기본 전열 확인: Basic Frontline Check Before the Boss
messages.셀렌 전 보스 전열 시간을 늘리는 방패병: Shieldbearer prolonging the frontline fight before Selen
messages.보스 전 도중 보물 방 집중력 점검: Testing Treasury awareness during the boss battle
messages.2장 보스. 점검표 심사를 들고 왕좌로 진입: Chapter 2 boss. Approaches the Throne with a checklist inspection
messages.셀렌: Stage 02 임시 심사관 성기사 견습 셀렌입니다. 점검표 17: Selen: Apprentice Paladin Selen, temporary Stage 02 inspector. I'll begin with checklist item 17: slip prevention in front of the Throne.
messages.바티: DAY 14 비용을 마련하지 못했다면 오늘 심사는 시작할 수 없습: Bati: Today's inspection cannot begin without the funds secured on DAY 14. The prepared funds remain intact.
messages.바티: 두 번째 승급은 아직 열지 않습니다. 오늘은 첫 승급 1명과 시설: Bati: The second promotion remains locked. Today, we pass the boss inspection with 1 promoted monster and facility placement.
messages.셀렌: 레온 선배의 보고서에는 '마왕성은 작지만 의외로 절차가 많음'이라: Selen: My senior Leon's report said, 'The Demon Castle is small, but has a surprising number of procedures.'
messages.바티: 보스는 후반에 들어옵니다. 중반 도둑을 놓치지 말고, 셀렌 전까지: Bati: The boss arrives late. Don't miss the mid-battle thief, and steady the front line before Selen arrives.
Chapter 2 boss defeated: Passed Apprentice Paladin Selen's Stage 02 inspection. (selen_boss_clear)
messages.성 진화 승인: 신생 마굴이 소마왕성으로 확장되며 모든 기본 방의 외형이: Castle evolution approved: The Fledgling Lair expands into a Lesser Demon Castle, replacing the visuals of all basic rooms. (stage_two_visual_enabled)
messages.셀렌의 점검표에서 왕국 보급로 지도가 떨어졌다. 로로는 안전하게 길을 읽: A map of royal supply routes fell from Selen's checklist. Rolo awaits your decision: safely scout the routes, or strike the warehouse first.
Before battle, confirm one supply route plan in Expeditions.
messages.보급로 선택이 같은 날 방어의 적 수와 도착 시점에 바로 반영된다. 정찰: The supply route choice immediately changes enemy numbers and arrival times in the same day's defense. Scouting offers safety; raiding offers big rewards and extra thieves.
Confirm one expedition plan for today in [Supply Route Choice] first.
Confirm one supply route expedition plan before the DAY 16 battle.
messages.로로가 두 보급로 계획의 실제 결과를 설명하고 원정대를 이끈다: Rolo explains the actual outcomes of the two supply route plans and leads the expedition
messages.추격해 온 도둑을 끊는 선택 가치가 드러난다: Reveals the value of choosing to intercept pursuing thieves
messages.늦게 도착하는 적을 입구에서 차례로 붙잡는다: Hold delayed enemies at the entrance one by one

Bati: Choose one: scout safely, or raid the warehouse for rewards. Try for both, and the expedition won't make it back.

Lesser Demon Castle operational: Stage 02 room visuals and the supply route operation are both active. (stage_two_visual_active)

messages.DAY 06에서 배운 보물 방 방어가 DAY 17에도 이어지는지 확인한다: Checks whether Treasury defense learned on DAY 06 carries through to DAY 17. Two separate infiltration timings and security ratings create tension and replay value instead of higher enemy HP.
messages.니아: 능선에서 발자국을 숨겼더라. 조용한 길이 어디로 이어지는지 확인하: Nia: You hid your tracks on the ridge. I came to see where that quiet path leads.
messages.니아: 보급창고를 그렇게 시끄럽게 털었으니, 가져간 물건이 어디에 쌓였는: Nia: You made quite a racket raiding that supply warehouse. I came to see where you piled up the goods.
Nia followed the hidden traces of the ridge scouting mission.
Nia followed the transport trail from the raided supply warehouse.
messages.두 번의 침투를 추격해 보물 방 진입을 끊는다: Pursue both infiltrations to prevent entry into the Treasury
messages.입구 전열을 붙잡아 고블린이 도둑 추격에 집중하게 한다: Hold the front line at the entrance so goblins can focus on chasing thieves
messages.두 번째 보안 평가와 결과 등급 발표: Second Security Evaluation and Results Grade
messages.첫 도둑 앞의 짧은 전열: Brief Frontline Fight Before the First Thief
messages.두 침투 사이에 수비 시선을 붙잡는 지원대: Support squad draws defenders' attention between infiltrations
messages.니아: 오늘은 한 번으로 끝내지 않을게. 두 번째 발소리까지 들을 수 있: Nia: I'm not stopping at one today. Let's see if you hear the second set of footsteps.
messages.골딘: 한 번 막았다고 장부를 덮지 마십시오. 오늘은 도둑이 서로 다른: Goldin: Don't close the ledger after stopping one thief. Today, they arrive at different times.
messages.고브: 입구 싸움은 푸딩에게 맡겨. 보라색 후드가 보이면 내가 끝까지 쫓: Gob: Leave the entrance fight to Pudding. If I see a purple hood, I'll chase it to the end.
Nia: The first one's a preview. Stop the second too, and I'll give you an S.
messages.바티: 도둑 둘은 함께 오지 않습니다. 첫 침투를 막은 뒤 추격 병력을: Bati: The two thieves won't arrive together. Recheck your pursuit troops after stopping the first infiltration.
messages.니아의 재평가 완료: 실제 침투와 약탈 기록으로 등급을 판정했다. (da: Nia's reassessment complete: Grade determined by actual infiltration and looting records. (day17_security_review_complete)
messages.니아가 남긴 침투 기록을 따라 왕국 봉쇄대가 두 길을 조인다. 이번에는: Following Nia's infiltration records, the royal blockade force tightens its grip on two routes. This time, we choose which threat remains.
messages.봉쇄 대응을 선택하세요. 도둑 둘을 추격할지, 방패병 둘을 정면에서 막을: Choose your blockade response. The enemy types change: pursue two thieves, or face two shieldbearers head-on.
messages.체력이나 공격력 상승 대신 도둑 압박과 방패병 압박 중 하나를 플레이어가: Let the player choose thief pressure or shieldbearer pressure instead of raising HP or attack. Goblin pursuit teams and slime frontline teams should offer different answers.
First, choose which enemy type to leave in [Blockade Response].
Confirm one blockade response operation before the DAY 18 battle.
Previous security grade S: You could handle the thieves and remove the investigator.
messages.지난 보안 평가 A: 도둑 대응은 가능하지만 보물 방 길목을 다시 확인해: Previous security grade A: Thieves are manageable, but recheck the Treasury chokepoints.
Previous security grade C: An operation that reduces thieves is favorable.
Previous security grade D: Blocking the smuggling tunnel to reduce thieves is safer.
messages.니아: 어제는 S였지. 내 도둑 둘을 그대로 두고 조사관만 속여도 버틸: Nia: You got an S yesterday. Confident you can leave my two thieves in play and just fool the investigator?
messages.니아: A면 추격은 됐지만 문 앞까지 내줬어. 오늘 도둑을 남길지는 신중: Nia: An A means you gave chase, but let us reach the door. Think carefully before leaving the thieves in play today.
messages.니아: 보물까지 손이 닿았던 C야. 밀수 갱도를 닫으면 도둑 하나는 돌려: Nia: That C means we got our hands on the treasure. Close the smuggling tunnel, and you can send one thief back.
messages.니아: D를 받고도 도둑 둘을 남기면 장부가 아니라 보물창고가 비게 될걸: Nia: Keep two thieves after getting a D, and it won't just be your ledger that's empty. It'll be your Treasury.
messages.가짜 장부 작전에서 남는 도둑 둘을 추격한다: Pursue the two thieves left by the false ledger operation
messages.갱도 봉쇄 작전에서 늘어나는 방패병 전열을 붙잡는다: Hold the reinforced shieldbearer front line from the tunnel blockade operation
messages.도둑 추격 또는 방패병 집중 공격을 지원한다: Support thief pursuit or focus fire on shieldbearers

messages.둘 중 하나의 위협만 남기는 대응 작전 지휘: Command the response operation that leaves only one of two threats
messages.가짜 장부와 밀수 갱도 작전 실행: Executing the False Ledger and Smuggling Tunnel Operations
messages.두 선택에 공통인 짧은 선발대: Brief Vanguard Shared by Both Choices
messages.가짜 장부 작전에서 그대로 남는 보물 방 압박: Treasury pressure left unchanged by the false ledger operation
messages.가짜 장부 작전에서 우회하는 지휘 지원: Command support diverted by the false ledger operation
messages.갱도 봉쇄 작전에서 한 명 늘어나는 정면 압박: Frontal pressure gains one unit under the tunnel blockade operation
messages.바티: 왕국 봉쇄대가 장부 길과 밀수 갱도를 동시에 막고 있습니다. 한쪽: Bati: The royal blockade force is blocking both the ledger route and the smuggling tunnel. Fool one side, and the other side's troops still come.
messages.로로: 가짜 장부를 흘리면 조사관은 빠지지만 도둑 둘이 옵니다. 갱도를: Rolo: Leak a false ledger, and the investigator leaves, but two thieves arrive. Block the tunnel, and one thief leaves while one shieldbearer joins.
messages.바티: 어제 등급과 현재 몬스터 조합을 보고, 우리가 상대하기 편한 위협: Bati: Consider yesterday's grade and your current monster lineup. Leave the threat we're better equipped to handle.
messages.바티: 선택한 봉쇄 대응이 적용됐습니다. 적 숫자가 아니라 남긴 적의 역: Bati: Your blockade response is in effect. Check the roles of the enemies left, not just their numbers.
messages.봉쇄선 돌파: 선택한 적 역할에 맞춰 수비 조합을 바꾸며 왕국 보급 추적: Blockade broken: Adapted the defense lineup to the chosen enemy roles and disrupted the kingdom's supply tracking. (day18_blockade_broken)
messages.왕국군이 어제 잃은 봉쇄 명령서와 지도를 되찾으러 온다. 전날 남긴 흔적: The royal army returns to retrieve the blockade orders and map lost yesterday. The traces you left change who leads the vanguard.
messages.새 선택은 없습니다. 초반 선발대를 정리한 뒤 36초 회수 도둑과 48초: No new choice today. Clear the early vanguard, then stop the retrieval thief at 36 seconds and the retrieval captain at 48 seconds.
messages.DAY 18 선택을 자동으로 전투에 계승하고, 필수 선택 화면 없이 준비: Automatically carry the DAY 18 choice into combat, returning to preparation and execution without a mandatory choice screen. Yesterday's choice changes only early enemy roles; late retrieval objectives are shared.
messages.아이리스: 세관 기록이 전부 가짜였군요. 이번에는 조사관 둘이 직접 명령: Iris: The customs records were all fake. This time, two investigators will retrieve the orders personally.
messages.바티: 무너뜨린 갱도 대신 왕국 방패병이 정문을 굳혔습니다. 회수대가 그: Bati: With the tunnel collapsed, Kingdom Shieldbearers have fortified the front gate approach. The retrieval squad advances behind that wall.
The two investigators fooled by the false ledger arrive as the vanguard.
Two shieldbearers abandon the blocked tunnel and approach the front gate.
messages.출현: 조사관 2 + 회수 도둑 + 회수대장: Enemies: 2 Investigators + Retrieval Thief + Retrieval Captain
messages.출현: 방패병 2 + 회수 도둑 + 회수대장: Enemies: 2 Shieldbearers + Retrieval Thief + Retrieval Captain
Iris: No more false coordinates. Two investigators will verify the route as we advance.
messages.바티: 예상대로 정문 방패병이 둘입니다. 한곳에 묶인 사이 후발대를 놓치: Bati: As expected, two shieldbearers at the front gate. Don't miss the reinforcements while you're tied down there.
messages.가짜 장부 후속전: 역추적 조사관과 명령서 회수대를 모두 격퇴했다. (d: False ledger aftermath: Repelled both the backtracking investigators and the orders retrieval squad. (day19_manifest_aftermath)
messages.갱도 봉쇄 후속전: 정문 방패대와 명령서 회수대를 모두 격퇴했다. (da: Tunnel blockade aftermath: Repelled both the front gate shield squad and the orders retrieval squad. (day19_tunnel_aftermath)
1 investigator is added in place of 1 shieldbearer.
Nia: Two investigators are fast, but there's no shield wall. Take the vanguard out early.
1 shieldbearer is added in place of 1 investigator.
Nia: Two shieldbearers are slow. Just don't get stuck on them and miss the purple hood behind.
messages.조사관 또는 방패병 둘을 한곳에 붙잡는다: Hold the two investigators or shieldbearers in one place
messages.전열을 돌아 명령서를 노리는 도둑을 추격한다: Chase the thief circling the front line to steal the orders
messages.수련생 용사가 전열에 합류하기 전에 집중 공격한다: Focus fire on the trainee hero before they join the front line
messages.가짜 장부 선택의 후속 추적 지휘: Commanding the follow-up pursuit after the false ledger choice
messages.회수 도둑 예고와 보안 평가: Retrieval Thief Warning and Security Evaluation
messages.가짜 장부 선택 시 둘로 늘어나는 빠른 선발대: Fast vanguard increases to two with the false ledger choice
messages.갱도 봉쇄 선택 시 둘로 늘어나는 정문 전열: Front gate line increases to two with the tunnel blockade choice
messages.보물 방의 봉쇄 명령서를 노리는 공통 회수 요원: Shared retrieval agent targeting the blockade orders in the Treasury
messages.회수 요원을 뒤따르는 공통 후반 대장: Shared late captain following the retrieval agent
messages.니아: 왕국 봉쇄 명령서 원본이 보물 보관실에 있어. 오늘 보라색 후드는: Nia: The original royal blockade orders are in the Treasury. Today, the purple hood will want that paper more than gold.
messages.바티: 전날 선택 때문에 초반 선발대만 달라집니다. 후반 회수 도둑과 대: Bati: Yesterday's choice changes only the early vanguard. The late retrieval thief and captain arrive in the same order.
messages.바티: 전열을 모두 입구에 묶지 마십시오. 36초부터 보물 방 추격 병력: Bati: Don't tie your entire front line to the entrance. We'll need troops chasing thieves near the Treasury from 36 seconds onward.
messages.바티: 선발대, 회수 도둑, 회수대장 순서입니다. 첫 교전 뒤 고블린의: Bati: Vanguard, retrieval thief, retrieval captain—in that order. Check the goblins' positions again after the first engagement.
messages.니아: 다음 발소리는 전열이 아니야. 명령서를 노리는 회수 도둑이 6초: Nia: Those next footsteps aren't frontline troops. A retrieval thief after the orders arrives in 6 seconds.
messages.바티: 회수대장 접근. 도둑 추격을 끝낸 병력부터 입구 전열로 복귀시키십: Bati: Retrieval captain approaching. Return troops to the entrance front line as soon as they finish chasing the thief.
messages.봉쇄 명령서 수호: 전날 작전의 후속대를 막고 왕국의 추적 경로를 끊었다: Blockade orders protected: Repelled the follow-up force from yesterday's operation and cut off the kingdom's pursuit route. (day19_recovery_team_defeated)
messages.보급 책임자 로만이 공병 작전서를 들고 직접 진입한다. 공병의 시설 교란: Quartermaster Roman enters personally with an engineering operations manual. Stop both the engineers' facility disruption and Roman's prolonged-battle supply command to evolve the Demon Castle into a Battle Fortress.
messages.3장 최종전입니다. 공병은 가까운 시설을 10초간 멈추고, 로만은 살아: Chapter 3's final battle. Sappers disable nearby facilities for 10 seconds, while Roman heals and protects surviving royal troops. Decide whether to stop the facility disruption or the commander first.
messages.출현: 탐험가 2 · 왕국 공병 2 · 방패병 1 · 조사관 1 · 보급: Enemies: 2 Explorers · 2 Kingdom Sappers · 1 Shieldbearer · 1 Investigator · 1 Quartermaster Roman
messages.3장 전체에서 다룬 보급로와 시설 방어를 한 전투에 묶는다. 공병의 시설: Combines the supply routes and facility defense covered throughout Chapter 3 in one battle. Survive both engineer facility shutdowns and Roman's functional supply command, then win to close the chapter and trigger Stage 03 evolution.
messages.전용 캐릭터 원화·초상·대기 2·이동 4·공격 4·스킬 4·쓰러짐 2프레: Complete this boss with dedicated character artwork, a portrait, 2 idle frames, 4 movement frames, 4 attack frames, 4 skill frames, 2 downed frames, and functional supply command for DAY 20.
messages.공병의 시설 진입로를 막아 교란 시간을 번다: Block the engineer's route to the facility to buy time before disruption
messages.목표 시설이 바뀌면 빠르게 추격 대상을 전환한다: Quickly switch pursuit targets when the target facility changes
messages.전열을 우회하는 공병에게 집중 화력을 사용한다: Focus fire on engineers bypassing the front line
messages.공병의 시설 목표와 대응 순서를 지휘: Direct the response order based on engineers' facility targets
messages.왕국이 전투 대신 시설 기능을 분석하기 시작했음을 알림: Announce that the kingdom has begun analyzing facility functions instead of combat
messages.규정과 보급표로 전열을 유지하는 3장 최종 지휘관: Chapter 3's final commander, sustaining the front line with regulations and supply charts
messages.첫 공병의 진입로를 여는 선두 정찰대: Lead scouts opening the first engineer's entry route
messages.가장 가까운 작동 중 시설을 10초간 무력화: Disable the nearest active facility for 10 seconds
messages.첫 공병 대응 뒤 흐트러진 전열을 붙잡는다: Tie up the front line disrupted by the first engineer response
messages.두 번째 시설 교란 뒤 남은 수비 상태를 압박한다: Pressure the remaining defenses after the second facility disruption
messages.실제 보급 지휘로 생존 왕국군을 회복·보호해 장기전을 강요한다: Force a prolonged battle by healing and protecting surviving royal troops through functional supply command
messages.아이리스: 왕좌 공격 기록보다 병영과 감시초소의 작동 시간을 먼저 조사했: Iris: I investigated Barracks and Watch Post uptime before the Throne attack records. Today, Kingdom Sappers will shut those systems down.
messages.바티: 공병은 가장 가까운 작동 중 시설을 목표로 삼습니다. 목표 시설은: Bati: Sappers target the nearest active facility. Their target appears immediately on the battle map and Facility Effects panel.
messages.바티: 첫 공병은 15초, 두 번째는 36초입니다. 한 명을 놓치더라도: Bati: First engineer at 15 seconds, second at 36. Even if one slips through, the shutdown ends automatically after 10 seconds.

messages.장부 밖의 독립 마왕성: An Independent Demon Castle, Off the Books
messages.로만은 장부의 마지막 줄에 마왕성을 압류 자산이 아닌 독립 협상 대상으로: On the ledger's final line, Roman listed the Demon Castle as an independent negotiating party, not an asset to seize.
Goldin flipped the counting board, complaining that the contract fee cost more than the independence gift.
The Demon Lord stamped the Throne seal upside down and insisted it was an official signature.
messages.마왕성이 자기 이름을 말했다: The Demon Castle Spoke Its Own Name
The room signs came together and spoke the name we had given the castle.
After the final battle, the heart everyone thought had gone dark lit every torch in the castle at once.
messages.방 표지판의 글자들이 스스로 움직여 마왕과 몬스터가 함께 지어 준 이름을: The letters on the room signs moved on their own, spelling the name the Demon Lord and monsters had chosen together.
The monsters hid their emotions by accusing each other of pulling a prank.
The Stonebone Heart sent a low pulse through every cracked wall, rebuilding the castle's bones.
The Devouring Heart swallowed the last ember, then lit every corridor with its warm breath.
messages.몽등 심장은 가짜 길을 모두 거두고, 집으로 돌아오는 단 하나의 길을 비: The Dream Lantern Heart dispelled every false path and lit the one road home.
There were no signatures, but every footprint pointed the same way.
The monsters patrolled the corridors in pairs, making a guard rotation of their own.
messages.마왕이 지휘관 서명을 하려 했지만, 종이에는 이미 발자국과 발톱 도장이: The Demon Lord tried to sign as commander, but the paper was already covered in footprints and claw stamps.
Bati: This document has no legal force. Its defensive force, however, is fully recognized.
Submit an invasion application in advance of your next visit.
messages.레온의 결투 규칙, 셀렌의 안전 점검표, 로만의 독립 계약서가 같은 문: Leon's duel rules, Selen's safety checklist, and Roman's independence contract all collided at the same gate.
Bati combined the three signature sections into a single Demon Castle armistice.
The Demon Lord ordered all three to submit invasion applications before their next visit.
Everyone who entered through different gates eventually met again in the same corridor.
messages.고기동 몬스터·구조 스킬 봉인: Seals high-mobility monsters and rescue skills
Use Gob or Koko to attack the Chainbearer first during the 0.9-second warning.
Pudding's taunt can change its target, or Bebe's broom can interrupt the cast.
Mori's cleanse halves the remaining movement seal duration.
messages.마법·상태 이상 저항 오라 전열: Frontline with a magic and status resistance aura
Use Toktok's Carapace Charge to reduce its high defense first.
It moves slowly, so Gob and Koko can eliminate the backline outside its aura first.
Hold the frontline with Pudding, then use Pynn's focused magic to eliminate the guard.
messages.상태 정화·심장 충전 억제: Cleanses status effects and suppresses Heart charge
Use Lumi's mark and Gob or Koko's pursuit to eliminate the exorcist during its 1.2-second cast.
Bebe's Broom Ruckus can interrupt the Purifying Hymn cast.
Place Toktok or Dolkong in the Heart Chamber to block its approach and casting.
messages.활약도가 높은 몬스터·계승 몬스터 집중 압박: Focuses pressure on high-performing and inherited monsters
Use Pudding or Koko's taunt to redirect basic attacks.
Keep the target alive with Bebe's rescue and protective monsters, or spread out contributions.
messages.방어·수리 조합 효율 억제: Reduces the effectiveness of defense and repair teams
Watch for the 0.8-second acid circle warning and escape with Bebe's rescue or direct movement.
Use Pynn or Lumi's ranged attacks to eliminate the alchemist first.
Toktok can avoid the repair penalty by repairing facilities from outside the acid zone.
messages.예산을 모아 시설 동결·용병 호출·긴급 보호막을 집행하는 길드 보스: Guild boss that accumulates budget to freeze facilities, summon mercenaries, and deploy emergency shields
messages.자산 동결 1초 예고 중 로만에게 피해 50을 집중하면 취소되고 감사 스: Deal 50 damage to Roman during Asset Freeze's 1-second warning to cancel it and build Audit Stress.
Defeat Guild support enemies first to reduce Roman's unspent budget.
Defeat mercenaries within 6 seconds of their arrival to add Audit Stress.
messages.시설 검수·축성 진군·최종 방벽을 운용하는 성정화 전선 보스: Holy Purification front boss using Facility Inspection, Consecrated March, and Final Barrier
messages.검수 중 셀렌에게 피해 55를 집중하면 시설 봉인을 취소하고 방어력을 낮: Deal 55 damage to Selen during inspection to cancel the facility seal and lower her defense.
Move monsters off consecrated ground to avoid status effects and reduced Heart charge.
messages.자비의 방벽이 생기면 4초 안에 모든 보호막을 깨 셀렌을 취약하게 만드세: When Barrier of Mercy appears, break all shields within 4 seconds to make Selen vulnerable.
messages.스킬 사용·심장 액티브 준비 압박: Pressures skill use and Heart active readiness
messages.장부 문양이 뜬 방에서는 표식이 사라질 때까지 액티브 스킬 사용을 조절하: In rooms displaying a ledger sigil, limit active skill use until the mark fades.
messages.곱·코코·루미로 구속술사를 먼저 쓰러뜨리면 해당 시전자의 표식이 즉시 해: Defeat the Binder first with Gob, Koko, or Lumi to remove that caster's marks immediately.
Mori's Cleansing Bloom or Bebe's Ghostly Transfer can remove room marks.

messages.현재 계산으로는 회수가 더 쌉니다. 내일 반대 증거가 없다면 그대로 집행: By my current calculations, repossession is cheaper. Unless tomorrow provides evidence to the contrary, I will proceed.
messages.보물과 시설을 지키고 장부 구속을 풀어 독립 비용을 감당하면 회수 대상에: Protect your treasure and facilities, break the ledger bonds, and bear the cost of independence to escape repossession.

messages.감사대가 어느 방을 먼저 셀지 알아. 이번엔 내가 그 길을 먼저 달릴 거: I know which room the audit team will count first. This time, I'll get there before they do.
Even if the facilities are frozen, I'll keep the flame going from the recovery area to the end.
messages.독립 축하금보다 계약 수수료가 비싸지만, 압류 비용보다는 싸게 만들겠습니: The contract fee costs more than the independence gift, but I'll make sure it's cheaper than seizure.
I'll appraise the Treasury myself. At least one notch above the Guild's ledger figures.

messages.서로의 성장을 읽은 마왕과 레온의 재결: A rematch between the Demon Lord and Leon, each aware of the other's growth
Leon folds his new map and writes an application for their next duel.
messages.살아 있는 성을 확인·봉인하려는 정화대의 절차: The Purifiers' procedure for inspecting and sealing a living castle
Selen changes 'Sealing' to 'Observation' on the checklist.
messages.회수 가능한 자산으로 분류된 마왕성의 독립 협상: Independence negotiations for a Demon Castle classified as a repossessable asset
Roman writes in the ledger: non-repossessable, independence negotiations required.
messages.레온이 마왕성 심장을 그린 지도를 두 장이나 발견했다. 두 장 모두 방의: Two maps Leon drew of the Demon Castle's heart have been found. Both have the room facing the wrong way, but correctly conclude that the Heart Chamber must be protected.
messages.레온이 몬스터 둘의 합동 동작을 관찰한 전술서를 남겼다. 반복 사용을 무: Leon left a tactical manual based on his observations of two monsters' coordinated moves. A note says he will counter once, without negating repeated use.
messages.레온은 장착한 합동기를 확인하지만 기존 적응 자세의 약점을 바꾸지는 않는: Leon checks the equipped team skill but does not change the weaknesses of his existing adaptive stances.
messages.서로의 이름으로 맺는 다음 결투: The Next Duel, Pledged in Your Own Names
messages.적응형 레온과 살아 있는 성: Adaptive Leon and the Living Castle
messages.레온은 기존 적응 자세를 유지한 채 심장 액티브와 합동기에 각각 한 번만: Leon keeps his existing adaptive stances and adds just one supporting response each to the Heart active and team skill.
messages.마왕성 밖의 돌에 성광이 잔상처럼 남았다. 아직은 정화대가 아닌 정찰의: Holy light lingers like an afterimage on a stone outside the Demon Castle. For now, it is a sign of scouting, not the Purifiers.
messages.봉인 사슬병이 처음 등장했다. 활약도가 높은 몬스터의 발을 묶으려는 준비: Sealing Chain Soldiers have appeared for the first time. Watch for their attempts to bind high-performing monsters and interrupt the cast.
messages.셀렌: 토벌이 아니라 점검입니다. 심장이 생명인지 위험한 마력원인지 절차: Selen: This is an inspection, not an extermination. We will follow procedure to determine whether the heart is alive or a dangerous source of mana.
messages.성광 적이 본격적으로 진입한다. 사슬병의 시전과 기존 방패병의 전열을 나: Holy enemies are entering in force. Handle the Chainbearers' casting separately from the existing Shieldbearer frontline.
messages.셀렌이 심장방 진입 절차를 요청했다. 이 전투에서 심장방은 처음으로 직접: Selen has requested entry to the Heart Chamber. In this battle, the chamber becomes a direct inspection target for the first time.
messages.성가 퇴마사가 심장 충전을 억제한다. 후열을 추격하되 셀렌의 점검전도 함: Hymn Exorcists suppress Heart charge. Pursue the backline while holding out through Selen's inspection battle.
messages.성물 호송대와 심장 봉인 시험: Relic Convoy and Heart Sealing Test
messages.정화대가 성물을 실은 수호기사를 앞세웠다. 보호 오라를 깨려면 서로 멀리: The Purifiers are led by guards carrying relics. To break their protective auras, pressure their widely separated frontlines individually.
Two Relic Guardian Knights and a Hymn Exorcist attempt to seal the Heart Chamber.
messages.셀렌이 정식 성기사 승인 전 마지막 절차를 요청했다. 아직 최종 결전은: Selen requests the final procedure before her approval as an official paladin. This is not yet the final battle.
Selen begins the preliminary duel alongside Sealing Chain Soldiers.
messages.DAY 30을 위한 성광 전선 작전 하나를 선택해야 한다. 효과와 대가는: Choose one Holy Front operation for DAY 30. Its effects and costs will be queued for the final battle.
messages.셀렌은 왕좌를 단숨에 파괴하지 않는다. 살아 있는 성의 존재를 끝까지 확: Selen does not destroy the Throne in one blow. She opens her final checklist to verify the living castle's existence to the very end.
messages.길드는 마왕성을 토벌 대상이 아니라 등록비가 밀린 회수 가능 자산으로 분: The Guild has classified the Demon Castle as a repossessable asset with overdue registration fees, rather than an extermination target. Bati sighs that fees began accruing the moment the castle entered the ledger.
messages.현상금 추적자가 최근 가장 크게 기여한 몬스터를 먼저 평가한다. 도둑의: Bounty Trackers first appraise the monster with the greatest recent contribution. Disrupt the thieves' treasure pressure and the targeted pursuit separately.
messages.로만은 회수 절차가 끝날 때까지 시설과 심장방을 임시 자산으로 동결하겠다: Roman announces that facilities and the Heart Chamber will be frozen as temporary assets until repossession is complete. The phrase 'an audit, not a battle' is even more threatening.
The Guild holds a hearing on the value and ownership of active facilities.
Battle Alchemists and Sappers suppress facility repairs while pressuring different rooms.
messages.로만이 보급 장부와 심장방 사용 기록을 함께 감사한다. 보물 약탈대는 배: Roman audits both the supply ledger and Heart Chamber usage records. Treasure raiders are excluded, but Ledger Binders record skill use as debt.
Roman commands the frontline while Ledger Binders head for the Heart Chamber.
messages.총감사관 승진 전 긴급 회수: Emergency Repossession Before Promotion to Grand Auditor
messages.승진 심사 전 마지막 회수 명령을 받은 로만이 직접 현장에 나온다. 현상: Given one last repossession order before his promotion review, Roman takes the field himself. Bounty Trackers separately target high-performing monsters.
An empowered Roman and Bounty Trackers split their pressure between the facility frontline and key monsters.
messages.DAY 30 총감사에 앞서 자산 장부를 위조하거나 용병 급여선을 끊을 수: Before the DAY 30 grand audit, you can forge the asset ledger or cut off mercenary pay.

messages.공병대의 예비 공구 수레를 교란해 DAY 30 시설 침투 인원을 한 명: Sabotage the Sappers' spare tool cart to reduce DAY 30 facility infiltrators by one.
Swap the relic list to weaken the guards and the first inspection.
Open a safe route for pilgrims to pass, delaying the Purifiers' arrival.
Forge the asset ledger to reduce assigned Binders and Roman's starting budget.
Cut the mercenary payroll to lower Roman's summon cap and the morale of regular Guild troops.

messages.전초기지 퇴각 통로에 은빛 커튼이 달렸다. 너무 예뻐서 병사들이 도망치기: Silver curtains appeared along the outpost's retreat route. They were so pretty that soldiers kept turning back for one last look before fleeing.
Silky began measuring the candidates' heads to make a cover for the upper-floor crown. Popo insisted counting ears was cheating.
messages.포포는 의회 초청장을 세 번 접어 작은 종이박쥐로 만들었다. 받는 사람은: Popo folded the council invitation three times into a tiny paper bat. The recipient found out late, but the paper bat reached the correct seat first.
Popo barely recovered Goldin's bundle of receipts from a rival Demon Lord's mailbox. The excuse that the amounts looked scarier than the address was rejected.

messages.마계 의회 정식 의석: An Official Seat on the Demon Realm Council
You have a seat and a voice, but must still win approval for the next proposal yourself.
The Demon Castle's name was engraved on the official seating chart, not a spectator's nameplate.
messages.세 경쟁 마왕은 박수와 견제를 함께 보냈고, 몬스터들은 다음 회기 간식표: The three rival Demon Lords offered both applause and caution, while the monsters checked the next session's snack schedule first.
Commands from the Throne must now pass through council records and promises to reach the whole demon realm.
The stairs became a record of saving one another, not a battlefront.
messages.왕관실과 왕좌실의 경보가 동시에 꺼지자 두 층의 몬스터들이 계단 한가운데: When the Crown Chamber and Throne Room alarms fell silent together, the monsters from both floors met halfway up the stairs.
The record sheet they had argued over—who held out longer—finally read: one castle's victory.
The Demon Castle had grown taller, but its command remained united.
The crown did not replace orders. It made trust visible.
The Demon Lord gave the starring role in the final record to the monster who had protected the crown.
messages.승리는 혼자 만든 것이 아니었고, 왕관의 빛도 다른 동료들의 이름을 지우: No one had won alone, and the crown's glow did not erase the names of the others.
messages.다음 초상화에서 마왕보다 먼저 보이는 것은 자랑스럽게 왕관을 쓴 작은 부: In the next portrait, the first thing to catch the eye was a small minion proudly wearing a crown, ahead of the Demon Lord.
messages.성 밖에도 우리 집이 있다: We Have a Home Beyond the Castle Too
The demolition consent form was found behind the snack storeroom, but no one signed it.
messages.임시 전초기지에는 어느새 침대와 간판과 몬스터마다 정해 둔 찻잔이 생겼다: The temporary outpost had somehow acquired beds, a sign, and a teacup for every monster.
messages.두 번의 습격을 버틴 깃발 아래에서 경비 교대보다 저녁 메뉴 회의가 먼저: Beneath the flag that had survived two raids, the dinner menu meeting took place before the guard change.
The little stronghold beyond the walls had become more than a place to return to. It was home.
messages.경쟁 마왕 셋의 공동 결재: Joint Approval by Three Rival Demon Lords
Joint approval was complete. Only the appendices on paper thickness, delivery, and humidity remained.
Brassa, Vesper, and Mirella pressed their seals onto a single agreement.
messages.서명은 금방 끝났지만 종이 두께와 배송 시간과 보관 습도 회의는 밤새 계: The signing was over quickly, but the meeting on paper thickness, delivery times, and storage humidity lasted all night.
The three rivals refused to back down, and so none of them was left alone.
messages.의회 해산, 각자 알아서 지켜요: Council Dissolved. Guard Your Own Castles.
The council is dissolved. The unofficial castle lords' gathering is next week, same time.
The Demon Lord declared that they could protect each other's castles without the council's permission.
messages.연단은 치워졌지만 세 경쟁 마왕은 간식과 지도를 들고 둥근 탁자로 돌아왔: The podium was removed, but the three rival Demon Lords returned to the round table with snacks and maps.
messages.각자의 깃발은 그대로였고, 위험이 오면 누구보다 먼저 같은 문으로 모일: Each kept their own flag, and when danger came, they would be the first to gather at the same gate.
messages.성벽도 움직여야 하나요?: Do Castle Walls Have to Move Too?
I want to shelter everyone, but I'm afraid wearing a crown will make me arrive last.
Your role is not to run ahead. It is to guard the room to the very end.
Then I'll carry the key. I don't want to drop it into a crack in your walls again.
messages.왕관은 번쩍여서 매복에 방해돼. 그래도 도망칠 길을 먼저 열 수 있다면: The crown's shine ruins an ambush. Still, I'll wear it if it helps open an escape route first.
Your role is to cut down dangerous enemies and make it back to your post.
I'll keep plenty of space open for your return. I won't swallow the key this time, either.
If this crown demands just one kind of flame, I'll pass. All three embers are mine.
Knowing which ember to choose for the situation is part of your role.
Fine. But if my mushroom umbrella catches fire, you're apologizing first.
messages.왕관보다 큰 우산이면 충분해요. 다친 아이가 그 아래로 들어올 수 있다면: An umbrella bigger than a crown is enough for me. As long as an injured little one can fit beneath it.
messages.네 역할은 승자를 고르는 게 아니라 쓰러질 아군을 한 번 더 일으키는 것: Your role is not to choose the winner. It is to help a falling ally stand once more.
I'll reinforce the umbrella shaft. Just keep the spores out of the screw holes.
messages.왕관도 판금이다. 가장 먼저 깨질 곳을 막는 데 쓸 수 있다면 규격은 합: A crown is plate metal too. If it can protect whatever will break first, it meets the standard.
Your role is to reinforce whichever is in greater danger: the facility or the armor.
My flames can heat it faster. As long as you don't hide the tongs again.
A crown may be heavy, but letters are light. I want to reach every floor on time.
Your role is to bring both support and the seal back to the floor in greatest danger.
I'll fold up the end of your cape. Catch it in a vent again and the delivery address changes.

messages.네 성의 계단 폭은 합격이다. 다만 난간 세 번째 이음새는 전투 두 번을: Your castle's stair width passes. The third railing joint, however, will struggle to survive two battles. I've marked it in red on the plans. Fix it.
messages.좋은 규칙은 망치보다 정확해야 한다. 찬성표는 보냈다. 대신 통과 뒤 시: A good rule must be more precise than a hammer. I've sent my vote in favor. In return, publish the facility load figures after it passes.
messages.철종 공방의 수정 도면: Revised Plans from the Ironbell Forge
messages.두 번째 표결은 말보다 구조가 중요하다. 네 안의 약한 모서리를 보강한: The second vote needs structure more than words. Enclosed are revised plans reinforcing the weak corners of your proposal. Pride is not a building material.
messages.오늘은 내가 직접 네 성을 두드린다. 금이 가면 결함이고, 버티면 규격이: Today, I'll hammer on your castle myself. If it cracks, it's a defect. If it holds, it's the standard. I'll handle repairs after the duel.
messages.왕관이든 왕좌든 내일은 버티는 쪽의 규격이 정식 규격으로 남는다. 철종은: Crown or Throne, tomorrow the one that holds will set the official standard. You may hang the iron bell in advance.
messages.귀 성의 상층 주소를 확인했습니다. 밤 2시 이후에는 동쪽 계단이 가장: We have confirmed your castle's upper-floor address. After 2 a.m., the eastern stairs are the fastest route. Please reply under the same seal.
messages.찬반 서류는 정시 배송했습니다. 귀하의 선택은 아직 봉인 상태입니다. 개: The documents for and against were delivered on time. Your choice remains sealed. Counting begins immediately after the bell rings three times.
Fog is delaying the northern air route. Voting correspondence will be routed through the upper-floor window. Please reply before midnight if you object.
messages.오늘의 도전장은 제가 직접 배달합니다. 수령 거부는 가능하지만, 반송 경: I will deliver today's challenge personally. You may refuse delivery, but the return route runs through the middle of the battlefield.
messages.도전 통지는 이미 배달됐습니다. 출발 시각은 정확하고, 긴급한 경로와 반: The challenge notice has already been delivered. Departure will be punctual. I will not disclose emergency routes or the return address.
messages.계단 이끼 관리법: How to Care for Stair Moss
messages.상층 계단의 이끼는 모두 걷지 않아도 괜찮아요. 가장자리만 남기면 발소리: You don't need to remove all the moss from the upper stairs. Leave some along the edges, and it will gently soften your footsteps.
messages.결정은 씨앗과 닮아서 바로 싹트지 않아요. 오늘 고른 조항에는 물을 조금: Decisions are like seeds; they don't sprout at once. Give today's chosen clause just a little water, so its roots aren't startled.
messages.두 번째 표결에는 너무 많은 가지가 보여요. 하나를 고르면 나머지는 조용: I see too many branches in the second vote. Choose one, and I'll quietly prune the others. Even the cut places will grow again.
messages.오늘은 성 안에 작은 정원을 만들 거예요. 잠들지 않으려면 안개 가장자리: I'll make a little garden inside the castle today. Watch the edges of the mist if you want to stay awake. I'll gather the wounded flowers.
messages.내일 정원은 오래 머물지 않아요. 왕관과 불을 준비하고, 쓰러진 아이들은: Tomorrow's garden won't linger long. Prepare the crown and fire, and let's tend to the fallen little ones together after the battle.
messages.계단 또는 문턱에 거미실을 설치해 처음 지나가는 적 4명을 4초 동안 3: Place webs on stairs or a doorway to slow the first 4 enemies passing through by 35% for 4 seconds.
messages.HP 35% 이하 아군을 안전 방향으로 당기고 최대 HP 10% 보호막을: Pull an ally at 35% HP or below toward safety and grant a shield equal to 10% of max HP.
Floor transfers are 40% faster, and allied collisions are ignored in the stair transfer queue.
Leave a small residual heat zone when entering the Crown Chamber or Heart Chamber.
Leave residual heat in the target room for 4 seconds. Identical zones do not stack.
messages.다른 층 또는 먼 위험 방의 아군에게 이동해 둘 모두 5초 동안 빠르게: Move to an ally on another floor or in a distant threatened room. Both move and attack faster for 5 seconds.
messages.8초 동안 은신·급습·인장 절도 적을 드러내고 목표 상호작용을 지연합니다: Reveal stealth, ambush, and seal theft enemies for 8 seconds and delay their objective interactions.
messages.전투당 첫 인장 절도를 5초 보류하고 포포가 절도범에게 도달하면 인장을: Delay the first seal theft each battle by 5 seconds. Popo recovers the seal upon reaching the thief.
messages.환기 통로 endpoint로 층을 이동하지만 왕좌로 직접 순간이동하지 않: Move between floors through a vent endpoint, without teleporting directly to the Throne.
Steal a seal over 4 seconds. Taking damage interrupts the theft; retry after 1 second.
Stop moving for 4 seconds and gain 25% defense.
messages.전투당 한 번 같은 층의 최근 기여 대상 뒤로 이동해 2초 동안 공격이: Once per battle, move behind a recent contributor on the same floor, gaining attack but losing defense for 2 seconds.
messages.5초 동안 적 회복을 높이고 플레이어 이동을 15% 낮추는 비중첩 구역을: Create a non-stacking zone for 5 seconds that boosts enemy healing and reduces player movement by 15%.
messages.문턱이나 계단에 6초 뿌리 장벽을 하나 만들며 피해 또는 정화로 제거할: Create one root barrier at a doorway or stairway for 6 seconds. Damage or cleansing can remove it.
Place one temporary, destructible iron wall that blocks movement for both sides.
Boost Bronze Automaton movement and attack, but also increase damage taken.
Telegraph a strike at the center of the current room, dealing minor extra damage to facilities.
After a warning, test the Crown Chamber and one active facility with the highest level.
messages.계단 endpoint를 거쳐 다른 층으로 급강하하고 도착 지점에 짧은 침: Dive to another floor through a stair endpoint, leaving a brief silence effect at the landing point.
Channel at the Seal Vault for 5 seconds, taking increased damage during the channel.
Swap valid positions with one active Twilight Courier.
messages.가장 최근에 사용된 플레이어 위치 스킬 하나의 재사용 대기시간을 늘립니다: Increase the cooldown of the player's most recently used positioning skill.
messages.방 하나를 7초 포자 정원으로 만들며 정화와 화염으로 지속시간을 줄일 수: Turn one room into a spore garden for 7 seconds. Cleansing and fire can shorten its duration.
messages.가장 강한 임시 버프 하나를 제거하는 대신 대상 HP를 15% 회복합니다: Remove the strongest temporary buff, but restore 15% of the target's HP.
Revive one fallen Spore Doll once at 30% max HP.
messages.왕관실 주변에 뿌리 3개를 만들고 모두 제거되면 미렐라의 방어가 8초 낮: Create 3 roots around the Crown Chamber. Removing all of them lowers Mirella's defense for 8 seconds.
messages.성 전체를 품는 젤: Gel That Shelters the Whole Castle
messages.6초 동안 같은 방 아군 피해를 30% 줄이고 푸딩이 일부를 대신 흡수합: Reduce damage to allies in the same room by 30% for 6 seconds, with Pudding absorbing part of it.
messages.두 번 베지 않는 명령: An Order That Needs No Second Strike
messages.왕명 표식 적과 인접 보조 적을 순차 공격한 뒤 원래 방으로 돌아오고 4: Strike the Royal Decree-marked enemy and a nearby secondary enemy in sequence, then return to the original room with reduced defense for 4 seconds.
messages.강한 화염구·화염 지대·잿불 저주 중 하나를 강화하며 세 불씨 순환과 반: Empower a Strong Fireball, Flame Zone, or Ember Curse, applying the three-ember cycle and repetition cost.
messages.같은 층 아군 전체를 정화하고 5초 재생하며 한 명의 전투 불능을 HP: Cleanse all allies on the same floor, grant regeneration for 5 seconds, and prevent one ally's incapacitation at 1 HP.
messages.가장 위험한 왕관실·인장 금고·시설을 최대 HP 30% 수리하고 8초 방: Repair the most endangered Crown Chamber, Seal Vault, or facility by 30% of max HP and protect it for 8 seconds.
messages.다른 층 아군에게 0.20초 만에 이동해 6초 공격·이동·상태 저항을 지: Reach an ally on another floor in 0.20 seconds and boost attack, movement, and status resistance for 6 seconds.
messages.응급 실밥 보호막 +5%p·시설 수리 12 / 거미실 대상 -1: Emergency Stitch shield +5%p · Facility repair 12 / Web targets -1
messages.중계 이동 +20%·공격 간격 -14% / 회수 보류 -1초: Relay movement +20% · Attack interval -14% / Recovery delay -1 second
messages.인장 보류 +2초·표식 피해 +10% / 중계 이동 +10%: Seal delay +2 seconds · Mark damage +10% / Relay movement +10%
messages.계단·왕관실·금고 사이 대응이 빠름: Fast responses between stairs, Crown Chamber, and vault
messages.광역 공격에 목표가 함께 노출됨: Area attacks expose multiple objectives at once
messages.왕관실과 금고 목표를 양쪽으로 분산: Splits Crown Chamber and vault objectives between two sides
messages.수비 몬스터도 양쪽으로 나뉨: Defending monsters must also split between both sides
messages.긴 이동 경로로 왕관실 진입 지연: Long travel route delays entry to the Crown Chamber

Increase defense while guarding the current room.
Instantly deal heavy damage to a nearby enemy.
Slightly increase gold rewards for battle victories.
Deal fire damage to a single target.
Deal area damage to enemies around the Spike Corridor.
Leave false trails for nearby enemies, slowing their movement for 3 seconds.
Slightly increase this battle's Infamy reward.
Restore 46 HP to the most wounded ally.
Restore 24 HP to allies in the same room and remove slow.
Gain +5 defense and 25% damage reduction for 8 seconds.
Damage nearby enemies and slow their movement.
Grant allies in the same room +2 defense for 7 seconds.
Restore 18 HP to allies in the same room.
Deal heavy damage to an enemy in range and make it pursue the caster.
Damage the nearest enemy and slow it for 2 seconds.
Lure nearby enemies and slow their movement for 3 seconds.
Heal the most wounded ally and safely move them to Mimi's position.
messages.HP 비율이 가장 낮은 아군을 안전 셀로 이동시키고 보호막 20을 부여합: Move the ally with the lowest HP ratio to a safe cell and grant a 20 shield.
messages.전방 부채꼴의 적에게 피해를 주고 일반 적을 밀치며 시전을 짧게 끊습니다: Damage enemies in a cone ahead, knock back normal enemies, and briefly interrupt casting.
Reduce disable duration by 12% while inside a facility or Heart Chamber, or in an adjacent room.
messages.0.9초 예고 뒤 대상의 이동을 2.2초, 액티브 스킬을 1.5초 봉인합: After a 0.9-second warning, seal the target's movement for 2.2 seconds and active skills for 1.5 seconds. The same target cannot be selected again for 5 seconds.
messages.적 하나를 7초 표식합니다. 코코는 추적 이동 속도 25%와 해당 대상: Mark one enemy for 7 seconds. Koko gains 25% pursuit movement speed and 10% basic attack damage against that target.
messages.반경 145 일반 적 최대 2명을 2.5초 도발합니다. 보스는 1.5초: Taunt up to 2 normal enemies within a radius of 145 for 2.5 seconds. Bosses prioritize Koko for 1.5 seconds, and Koko gains an 18 shield.
messages.표식 대상 처치 또는 이탈 뒤 최대 4초 동안 배치 방으로 35% 빠르게: After a marked target is defeated or leaves, return to the assigned room 35% faster for up to 4 seconds, taking 8% less damage.
messages.최근 20초 기여 1위 생존 몬스터를 6초 표적화합니다. 추적자가 표적에: Target the surviving monster ranked 1st in contribution over the last 20 seconds for 6 seconds. The tracker's damage to the target increases by up to 15%.
messages.전방 최대 110px를 돌진해 처음 부딪힌 적에게 피해를 주고, 일반 적: Charge up to 110px forward, damaging the first enemy hit and applying -2 defense to normal enemies (5 seconds) or -1 to bosses (4 seconds). The reduction does not stack; only its duration refreshes.
messages.시설·심장실 하나를 35 수리하거나 아군 하나에게 5초 보호막 28을 줍: Repair one facility or Heart Chamber by 35, or give one ally a 28 shield for 5 seconds. Both effects cannot apply at once. Each scrap adds 8 to the effect.
messages.적 보호막 파괴, 시설에 30 이상 피해, 방어력 감소 성공 시 고철 1: Gain 1 scrap when breaking an enemy shield, dealing at least 30 damage to a facility, or successfully reducing defense (max 3). The next Patchwork Plating consumes all scrap.
messages.0.8초 예고 후 반경 85의 산성 장판을 5초 생성합니다. 안의 몬스터: After a 0.8-second warning, create an acid zone with a radius of 85 for 5 seconds. Monsters inside suffer -2 defense, -40% repairs, and 2 damage per second. Effects do not stack.
messages.반경 155 아군의 받는 마법 피해를 15%, 상태 이상 지속시간과 사기: Reduce magic damage taken by allies within a radius of 155 by 15%, and status effect duration and morale damage by 25%. Auras do not stack, and the guard's movement speed decreases by 8%.
messages.1.2초 시전 후 반경 180 아군 최대 3명의 약화 효과를 하나씩 제거: After a 1.2-second cast, remove one debuff each from up to 3 allies within a radius of 180. Completing the cast inside the Heart Chamber blocks new Heart charge for 4 seconds while preserving existing charge.
messages.1초 예고 후 시설 또는 심장방을 7초 표식합니다. 그 방의 몬스터가 액: After a 1-second warning, mark a facility or Heart Chamber for 7 seconds. If monsters in that room use active skills three times, the room takes 20 damage and is disabled for 3 seconds. The Heart Chamber also locks its Heart active for 3 seconds.
messages.6초 동안 모든 활성 시설과 심장실에 보호막 45를 주고 방 내부 몬스터: Grant all active facilities and the Heart Chamber a 45 shield for 6 seconds, and reduce damage taken by monsters inside those rooms by 12%.
messages.왕좌 HP 35를 소모해 선택한 방을 5초 동안 포식합니다. 적에게 초당: Spend 35 Throne HP to devour the selected room for 5 seconds, dealing 6 damage per second to enemies and slowing their movement.
messages.기여도가 높은 시설 또는 심장방을 1초간 표시합니다. 표시 중 로만에게: Mark a high-contributing facility or Heart Chamber for 1 second. Deal 50 damage to Roman during the mark to cancel it.
messages.예산 2를 써 현상금 추적자 또는 전투 연금술사 한 명을 호출합니다. 전: Spend 2 budget to summon one Bounty Tracker or Battle Alchemist, up to 2 per battle. Cannot move while summoning.
messages.남은 예산을 보호막으로 전환하고 주변 길드 병력의 체력을 12 회복합니다: Convert remaining budget into a shield and restore 12 HP to nearby Guild troops. Gain an 18 shield even with 0 budget.
messages.대응에 성공할수록 로만의 스킬 재사용 시간이 늘어납니다. 3중첩부터 느려: Successful counters increase Roman's skill cooldowns. He slows at 3 stacks and pauses once at 5 stacks to sort paperwork for 2 seconds.
messages.활성 시설이나 심장실을 5초간 검수합니다. 검수 중 셀렌에게 피해 55를: Inspect an active facility or Heart Chamber for 5 seconds. Deal 55 damage to Selen during inspection to cancel it and reduce her defense by 2 for 2 seconds.
messages.이동 경로에 최대 2개의 축성 바닥을 남깁니다. 안의 몬스터는 상태 효과: Leave up to 2 patches of consecrated ground along the movement route. Monsters inside have 20% shorter status effect durations and 25% lower Heart charge efficiency.
messages.셀렌과 살아 있는 성정화 병력에게 보호막을 부여합니다. 4초 안에 전부: Grant shields to Selen and surviving Holy Purification troops. Destroy all shields within 4 seconds to increase damage Selen takes by 18% for 2.5 seconds.
messages.검수를 세 번 연속 시도합니다. 두 번 이상 막으면 마지막 방벽이 25: Attempt three consecutive inspections. Blocking at least two reduces the final barrier by 25. Allowing all three locks the Heart Chamber and one facility simultaneously for 4 seconds.
messages.일반 적 최대 2명을 6초 동안 미끼 방으로 유도합니다. 보스는 경로 대: Lure up to 2 normal enemies to a decoy room for 6 seconds. Bosses keep their route but move 12% slower for 3 seconds.
Guard the space between the entrance and Spike Corridor, holding off the first enemy breakthrough longer.
Move toward low-HP allies and intercept pursuing enemies.
